scope: AOT Release layout stress and native geometry checks. CPU and memory values are whole-process metrics.

workload.update: On each app frame callback the host alternates the cell width between 8 and 10 logical units. For the benchmark the generated parent width is driven by the size parameter in both variants.
workload.candidate: Swift candidate uses one frame with an in-primitive visibility guard. Compose candidate replaces the empty Box with Spacer under the same sizing and color modifiers. Neither experimental drawing variant was adopted.

platforms.ios: iPhone 18 Pro Max simulator, iOS 27.0; CADisplayLink target 60 Hz
platforms.android: emulator-5554, Android 12 API 31; ART speed compilation per installation; most recent gfxinfo frame records

retention.scope: Original positive-thickness fixture. Both devices ran concurrently with workspace compilation. Process memory is reported independently from comparison timings.

iosPositiveCandidateGeometry.result: Dimensions and rendered pixels matched in standalone, vertical and horizontal layouts with two colors and five positive thicknesses.
